variant: Hubs, rooms, devices, and concurrent PATCH

domain_invariants.requirement: A hub has a unique positive id, one owner, a globally unique serial matching ^[A-Z0-9-]{8,32}$, a name of 1..80 characters, timezone from the IANA subset Europe/Rome, Europe/London, UTC, America/New_York, or Asia/Tokyo, and revision starting at 1.
A room belongs to exactly one existing hub, has a name of 1..60 characters unique case-insensitively within that hub, floor integer -5..200, and revision starting at 1.

A device belongs to exactly one existing hub and optionally one room of that same hub, has a per-hub unique label of 1..80 characters, address matching ^[A-F0-9]{12}$ unique within its hub, type SENSOR, LIGHT, SWITCH, THERMOSTAT, or LOCK, and revision starting at 1.
A hub contains at most 64 devices and a room contains at most 32 devices; assigning or moving a device must preserve both capacity limits atomically.

Every mutable hub, room, and device representation exposes its current revision as a strong ETag formatted "<positive-integer>". A PATCH requires an exact If-Match ETag; missing, malformed, or stale ETags never modify state.
A successful PATCH updates only supplied non-null fields and increments the resource revision by exactly one, including a semantically identical supplied value; no other resource revision changes.
A rejected concurrent PATCH returns 409 when If-Match does not equal the current revision, and its response includes the current ETag; it leaves the target and every related resource unchanged.

A hub cannot be deleted while it has rooms or devices. A room cannot be deleted while it has devices. Deleting an unreferenced room or hub cascades no unrelated records; deleting a device removes only that device.
A user may access and modify only hubs owned by that user and their rooms and devices; an admin may access every resource. A resource can never be moved to a hub owned by a different user.
Topology is acyclic by construction: rooms cannot belong to rooms, a device has one hub, and its room is null or belongs to that hub. Private routes deny by default.

seed_data: Deterministic local users exist with ids 1 and 2 in role user and id 3 in role admin. Private routes require a valid non-expired server-side Bearer session; session values are not returned.

All lists use immutable numeric id ascending order, limit 1..100 default 20, optional after_id > 0, and response fields items and next_after_id where null means exhaustion. Optional filters are exact: hub_id, room_id, type, and unassigned boolean; a supplied parent id must be positive and exist.

Write bodies use application/json. Invalid JSON is 400, wrong write media type is 415, and structurally or domain-invalid fields are 422. For private routes deny by default. Local persistence unavailability is 503 and unexpected local failure is 500; neither may persist a partial write.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health as a public endpoint with no input or authorization; it shall return deterministic local persistence health without persistent effects and emit only 200 or 503.

The system shall expose GET /hubs as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting optional owner_id for admins only, timezone enum, limit, and after_id; it shall apply exact filters, enforce REQ-2-009, use stable pagination, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /hubs as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json serial, name, and timezone, with optional owner_id permitted only to admins; it shall validate REQ-2-001, set a user caller as owner, reject duplicate serials, atomically create revision 1, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location and ETag, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /hubs/{hub_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall return the hub with current revision ETag after authorization, make no persistent changes, treat non-positive or absent ids as 404, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose PATCH /hubs/{hub_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json with one or both of name and timezone plus a required exact If-Match ETag; it shall validate a non-empty non-null patch and REQ-2-001 and REQ-2-005, atomically update only supplied fields and increment only the hub revision, be non-idempotent because identical payloads advance revision, return 200 with new ETag, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /hubs/{hub_id} as an authenticated owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall atomically delete only a hub with no rooms and no devices, shall not cascade-delete child resources, be non-idempotent after success, return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /rooms as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting optional hub_id, floor integer -5..200, limit, and after_id; it shall validate a supplied existing parent hub, enforce ownership through the hub, use stable pagination, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /rooms as an authenticated hub-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json hub_id, name, and floor; it shall validate REQ-2-002 and a positive existing accessible hub, reject a case-insensitive duplicate name in that hub, atomically create revision 1, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location and ETag, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /rooms/{room_id} as an authenticated room-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall return the room with current revision ETag after hub ownership authorization, make no persistent changes, treat non-positive or absent ids as 404, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetRoom(request, room_id):
    // REQ-2-019; Preconditions: persistence available. REQUIRE authenticated caller or RETURN 401.
    IF room_id <= 0 OR room absent THEN RETURN 404. IF user caller does not own room.hub THEN RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200 with room and current ETag. // Transaction: none; persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /rooms/{room_id} as an authenticated room-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json with one or both of name and floor plus required exact If-Match; it shall validate REQ-2-002, REQ-2-005, and case-insensitive name uniqueness in the existing hub, atomically update only supplied fields and increment only room revision, be non-idempotent because every success advances revision, return 200 with new ETag, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /rooms/{room_id} as an authenticated room-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall atomically delete only an empty room, reject deletion when any device references it without detaching devices, be non-idempotent after success, return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /devices as an authenticated user-or-admin endpoint accepting optional hub_id, room_id, type enum, unassigned boolean, limit, and after_id; it shall apply exact filters where unassigned true means room_id is null and false means non-null, validate supplied parents and their ownership, use stable pagination, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /devices as an authenticated hub-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json hub_id, optional room_id, label, address, and type; it shall validate REQ-2-003, REQ-2-004, and REQ-2-010, require accessible same-hub room if supplied, reject duplicate per-hub label or address, atomically create revision 1, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location and ETag, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /devices/{device_id} as an authenticated device-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall return the device and current revision ETag after hub ownership authorization, make no persistent changes, treat non-positive or absent ids as 404, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetDevice(request, device_id):
    // REQ-2-024; Preconditions: persistence available. REQUIRE authenticated caller or RETURN 401.
    IF device_id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404. IF user caller does not own device.hub THEN RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200 with device and ETag. // Transaction none; all state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /devices/{device_id} as an authenticated device-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting application/json with one or more supplied fields from non-null label, nullable room_id, and non-null type plus required exact If-Match; it shall validate REQ-2-003 through REQ-2-007 and REQ-2-010, treat room_id null as deliberate unassignment, atomically update only supplied fields and increment only device revision, be non-idempotent because every success advances revision, return 200 with new ETag, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /devices/{device_id} as an authenticated device-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall atomically delete only the selected device without changing its hub or room revisions and without cascading to any other resource, be non-idempotent after success, return 204, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /hubs/{hub_id}/topology as an authenticated hub-owner-or-admin endpoint accepting a positive path id; it shall return the hub, rooms ordered by id, and devices ordered by id with room assignments, enforce REQ-2-010, make no persistent changes, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.
